name: kb_affliction_warlock
notes: The Turtle knowledge base's affliction raid list: Curse of Agony, Corruption and Siphon Life kept up, Dark Harvest only under Shadow Vulnerability, Shadow Bolt on a Nightfall (Shadow Trance) proc, Drain Soul as the filler, Life Tap when the mana runs out, and Hellfire/Rain of Fire on five or more stacked mobs. The assigned raid curse, the DoT snapshotting and the opener order are not conditions (kb.unexpressed). Immolate and a hard-cast Shadow Bolt are the oracle's never list.

priorities.note: the KB gives no number: 25% is this recipe's (the shipped warlock uses 25% in combat).
Moved after the AoE entry: the filler has no cooldown, so as a rule it would starve the AoE casts the KB lists after it.
"emergency self-heal": 50% is the phrase table's default where the KB gives no number.
